user.title: Add a plant
user.description: Choose the plant's soil moisture sensor. The name and battery sensor will be suggested from its device.

plant.title: Your plant
plant.description: Check the suggested details for the {moisture_entity} sensor. The plant type sets the starting moisture thresholds. Enter the species ("Ficus elastica", "Monstera"…) to fetch its photo and description, and its thresholds when an OpenPlantbook account is set up.

species.title: Choose the species
species.description: Select the species matching your plant. Select nothing to continue without a species.

reconfigure.title: Change sensors
reconfigure.description: Select the sensors of {plant_name}. Clear the battery field to stop tracking the battery.

error.moisture_already_used: This moisture sensor is already assigned to another plant.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Wikipedia or OpenPlantbook. Check Home Assistant's Internet connection.
error.species_not_found: No species found. Try the scientific name or another common name.

abort.already_configured: This moisture sensor is already assigned to a plant.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The plant sensors have been updated.

settings.title: Plant settings
settings.description: Configure thresholds, image and notifications. You can select several target devices. The high moisture threshold must be greater than the watering threshold. During quiet hours, notifications wait for the end of the period.

data.reminder_hours: Remind if still dry after (hours, 0 = never)

species.title: Species and photo
species.description: Search the species to fetch its photo and description (and its thresholds with OpenPlantbook); submit the same species to refresh its photo. You can also upload your own photo, which will be kept. Clear the species to remove it.

species_select.title: Choose the species
species_select.description: Select the species matching your plant. Select nothing to continue without a species.

plantbook.title: OpenPlantbook account
plantbook.description: OpenPlantbook provides moisture thresholds for many species. Create a free account, then copy your API credentials from {url}. They are used for all your plants. Account set up: {status}. Clear both fields to remove it.

error.invalid_thresholds: The high moisture threshold must be greater than the watering threshold.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Wikipedia or OpenPlantbook. Check Home Assistant's Internet connection.
error.species_not_found: No species found. Try the scientific name or another common name.
error.invalid_auth: OpenPlantbook rejected the credentials. Check the Client ID and Client secret.
error.invalid_photo: This file is not a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP image under 5 MB.
